jobs.description:
**European Patent Examiner in Electrical Engineering (Electric Power Distribution \& Protection) (22637\)**

  

**Duration of contract:** Five years, renewable (full\-time)
  

**Location:** Germany (Munich/Berlin) or the Netherlands (The Hague)
  

**Application deadline:** 2 November 2026

  

  

**At the European Patent Office (EPO), we explore breakthrough technologies before they reach the public.** As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future.  

We are an inclusive, purpose\-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO.  

**Your role and impact**
As a Patent Examiner, you will:
* **examine patent applications** – including technical documentation and drawings – in one of our official languages (English, French or German)
* **analyse new inventions** to evaluate their novelty and inventive step
* **conduct in\-depth research** using digital search tools, scientific databases and patent information sources to identify the most relevant prior art
* **apply legal and procedural frameworks** to make clear, high\-quality decisions on whether a patent should be granted
* **communicate your findings** clearly and constructively with applicants and other parties
* **collaborate with international colleagues** in a diverse and inclusive environment
* **maintain high\-quality standards** with strong attention to detail and scientific rigour
* **contribute to Europe's innovation ecosystem** by ensuring fair and consistent application of the European Patent Convention (EPC) and related legal texts
  

**Your profile**
**We're looking for expertise in at least one of these fields:**
* Electric Power Distribution \& Protection: background as electrical engineer or physicist with similar expertise, preferably with background in electric power distribution (e.g. from renewable energy sources, such as photovoltaic systems, wind turbines, hydropower plants etc, to grid/power networks) via AC and/or DC lines (including HVDC), power conversion, energy storage, wireless power transfer and battery charging technologies (e.g. EVs/HEVs charging) and preferably Emergency Protective Circuit Arrangements.
  

**You will thrive with us if you**
* have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience
* enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles
* are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law
* are analytical, detail\-oriented and open\-minded
* are confident using digital technologies and AI\-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking
* value both independent work and team collaboration
* are comfortable making structured, evidence\-based decisions
  

No prior IP(intellectual property) experience? No problem.
We provide full legal and procedural training to get you started.  

  

**Our minimum requirements for this post**
* Diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above
* Excellent knowledge (at least C1\) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1\) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required)
* Work experience in industry would be an advantage
* Citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation
  

**What we offer**
* competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience)
* 30\+ days of annual leave \+ flexible working arrangements
* generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states)
* family\-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support
* pension and insurance: excellent social security coverage
* examiner training: a comprehensive two\-year development programme covering all aspects of patent search and examination, starting with a six\-week Academy programme on\-site and delivered in English
* inclusive culture: 35\+ nationalities, supportive networks and a strong DEI commitment
* facilities: on\-site gym, health services, staff clubs and more (depending on location)
* top locations: high quality of life and a thriving international community
* (see full list of benefits)
  

**What to expect next**
We are recruiting for positions starting from 2027 and are already building a talent pool for upcoming roles in 2028\. If selected to join our talent pool, you'll get:  

* priority access to future vacancies
* exclusive access to learning offers and resources to enhance your IP awareness and your readiness to become a patent examiner
* regular updates and insights
  

Being a member of the talent pool gives you a chance to join our journey from the very beginning and to be fully prepared for when the next positions go live.

Such talent pools are valid for a period of 24 months and talent pool candidates may be contacted should a vacancy with substantially the same profile arise during that period.

jobs.description:

**RWE Supply \& Trading GmbH**


**Start date:** September 2027  

**Salary:** starting at £41,000 p.a


Are you looking to kickstart your career at a company where you can truly make an impact? Whether we’re delivering power to millions, trading in new markets around the globe, or driving the rapid growth of renewable energy, RWE is at the forefront of the industry. But we wouldn’t be there without world\-class IT.

  

  

**About the role**


The IT Developer Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who want to build a career in software engineering and application development, placing you at the heart of our commercial business.


Through a series of hands\-on technical rotations, you’ll work closely with analysts and business support teams to deliver solutions for our energy trading and commercial operations teams, while developing expertise in programming, cloud\-native technologies and DevOps practices.


Along the way, you’ll broaden your technical stack and business knowledge, gain experience across a range of programming languages and working environments, and build an understanding of different teams and cultures, providing a strong foundation for your permanent role and long\-term career development.


You’ll learn about our global business from the inside – working on meaningful projects in areas including:


* Application development.
* Embedded IT for our commercial business such as trading of energy commodities, freight and logistics, commercial asset optimisation or sales and origination.
* Enterprise Integration focus on the transport layer within RWEST’s application landscape and works closely together with other IT and business teams to optimise the systems.
* Market Data Solutions are the fuel for decision\-making, automated trading, and fundamental analysis within the Energy Trading industry.
* Central Services are positioned in middle layer (Integration) applications connecting to various other departments like BackOffice, Risk and Front Office etc. involving incident management, automated standard service requests, working with concepts of DevOps and Squad model and migration of application to cloud based infrastructure.
* IT projects with business attention such as “Lead in Data” or “Lead in Cloud”.

Digital technologies, including AI\-enabled tools, are becoming an integral part of how we work at RWE. Throughout the programme, you will have opportunities to use these tools responsibly to enhance productivity, support decision\-making, foster innovation and improve ways of working, always in line with RWE policies and responsible use principles.


Whichever team you join, you’ll be welcomed as an equal. Your perspective will be valued. You’ll be trusted to deliver the work you’re given. And with each new rotation, you’ll develop the skills and knowledge you need to become an industry expert.

  

  

**Job requirements and experiences**

Are you passionate about IT, digital technologies, and innovative solutions? Committed to building a career in the energy industry? Keen to learn, grow and take ownership and accountability? Then you could be just the kind of exceptional person we’re looking for. Some relevant work experience would be an advantage but is not essential.

  

  

As well as a keen interest in the energy industry and the readiness to explore our markets and our business, you’ll need:


* A degree (BSc, MSc or PhD) in IT or a similar statistical or numerate subject such as Mathematics, Engineering or Economics.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages \- C\#, Java or Python.
* Passion for IT development and working in a DevOps environment.
* Interest in AI, Automation, and other emerging technologies.
* A positive, team\-oriented approach to work.
* Motivation to take on new challenges.
* A commercial and analytical mindset.
* Adaptability and the ability to learn quickly.
* Enthusiasm for developing your skills and exploring new opportunities.
* Fluent English.
  

  

**From here, you’ll have a community of support**


While you’re on our graduate journey, we’re committed to providing you with a range of opportunities to grow and develop your skills. Alongside job rotations and technical training, you’ll be provided with comprehensive behavioural skills training with our expert partner, Cappfinity. This will enable you to harness your strengths from day one and identify new ways to utilise the key Skills That Build Skills. This will support you to reach your potential and goals, shaping your career path. The behavioural skills training is immersive, including interactive sessions where you can learn from our facilitators and your own peers, and self\-led elements to support your application of learning back in your day\-to\-day role.


Our graduate programmes have been designed to give you the chance to shape your own career path and personal development, with the support you need to succeed. You’ll have access to a graduate buddy and a senior mentor within your field who can advise you on rotations and introduce you to key people within the business.


RWE is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment – we value your passion, your willingness to learn and your desire to thrive. Even if you don't have all the above skills, need flexible working arrangements or other adjustments not yet listed here, we'd love to hear from you.

  

  

**Your benefits**


At RWE, we’ll do everything we can to support you in fulfilling your potential. Our benefits include:


* Competitive salary plus annual discretionary bonus.
* Company pension and discounted employee share scheme.
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy 5 extra days.
* Two paid annual volunteer days for a charity or initiative of your choice.
* International rotations with financial support for relocation.
* Enhanced family\-friendly policies, including maternity support.
* Free on\-site healthcare and access to AXA Private Healthcare Scheme.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with confidential support for work, health, or life matters.
* Access to modern offices, state\-of\-the\-art IT and diverse employee networks.
* Flexible benefits, including retail discounts.

**Apply with just a few clicks:** ad code **93668,** application period: **14/10/2026**
  

Any questions? **Contact HR:** Early Careers Recruitment Team, rwest\_early\_careers\_recruitment@rwe.com


Please upload your resume and cover letter in English as one document. Should you progress through the interview process, you will be asked to share a copy of your transcript.


Find out more on rwe.com/graduates

  

  

We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too.
  

  

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications \- regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. \#inclusionmatters
  

  

RWE Supply \& Trading is our connection to the world’s energy markets. Headquartered in Essen, Germany, the company operates one of Europe’s largest and most advanced energy trading floors. A diverse team of over 2,300 professionals from around 90 countries trades electricity, gas, commodities, and CO2 emission allowances. With precise market analysis and a strong customer focus, we create innovative energy supply solutions and tailored risk management concepts for industrial clients.
  

  

We also ensure the commercial optimisation of RWE’s power plant portfolio and market the electricity generated by RWE. In addition, legally independent RWE gas storage companies operate in Germany, contributing to a secure energy supply.

**About the job:**


We are recruiting for a Graduate Civil / Structural Engineer to be based in Kent’s Woking office.


Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?


Our Civil and Structural engineering team in Woking UK operates globally in both the Onshore and Offshore energy sectors and are working towards energy supply, sustainability and reducing carbon emissions. As a graduate in our engineering team you will be contributing to a variety of technically challenging and exciting projects, designing new onshore and potentially offshore energy projects, developing carbon capture and energy storage solutions, developing sustainable fuel facilities which may involve site visits to our client’s global installations.


The successful candidate(s) will join our Graduate Development Programme within our engineering team in Woking with duties including, but not limited to, those outlined below.


**About our Graduate Scheme**


Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.


If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future\-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.


Our global graduate program offers hands\-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.


**Application Process**


As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.


**Application Deadline**


All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.


**Recruitment Timeline**


Shortlisting and pre\-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026\.


**Eligibility**


Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.


**Hybrid Working**


We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.


**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**


**Skills \& Responsibilities:**


You will be joining our Woking Engineering Office team, working in conjunction with Kent’s global offices and resources to actively encourage and foster innovative solutions and new approaches to solve our client’s problems.

ReproHub develops infrastructure for researchers working with secondary and sensitive data. The project builds on existing Dutch open science infrastructure, including ODISSEI and Tilburg Science Hub, and aims to strengthen reproducibility, transparency, and public trust in science.

Your position

As a research software engineer based at Library & Information Services at Tilburg University, you will contribute to the technical development and integration of ReproHub, a large-scale open science infrastructure project recently funded by OpenScienceNL/NWO. Specifically, you will be part of the project’s technical development team and help translate stakeholder needs into reliable, maintainable, and secure software.

ReproHub (see project proposal for details) consists of four connected deliverables:
ReproBuddy: an AI tool based on open-source LLMs to improve reproducibility packages using commonly used workflows in the social sciences
ReproRun: a system to validate research results and provide certificates
OpenScienceRadar: a browser extension that makes open resources from public databases visible alongside search results (e.g., in Google Search)
OpenScienceHub.nl: scaling Tilburg Science Hub to become a national platform with accessible educational material on Dutch and European open science infrastructure

Important activities include:
Developing frontend and backend components for ReproHub’s tools and services;
designing, building, and maintaining APIs and integrations between the different components;
Contributing to API-based integration of LLM functionality, including context-retrieval approaches and open-source large language models;
Helping build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployment workflows, and Kubernetes-based deployment;
Developing and improving user interfaces for researchers, research support staff, and other users;
Reviewing code, auditing pull requests, and maintaining technical documentation;

Experience with, or willingness to learn, technical infrastructure such as Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, cloud deployment, monitoring, and secure software development practices.

Is accurate, curious, pragmatic, and communicative; takes ownership of technical work while remaining open to feedback from users and colleagues.
Experience with open-source projects, research data workflows, browser extension development, university IT environments, or Dutch language skills is an advantage.

Employment of 0.7 – 1.0 fte (28 - 40 hours per week).

Want to apply?

We kindly invite you to apply before October 4th

to join our AI Engineering team. This is a hands-on, full-stack role
focused on building the front-end and back-end application layers that enable AI teams to deliver enterprise solutions.

You will work alongside AI engineers, data scientists, platform engineers, product teams to move AI use cases from proof of concept into secure, scalable and supportable products. Full-stack application engineering

Design, build and maintain production-grade web applications that expose AI capabilities through clear, responsive and accessible user experiences.
Develop component-based front ends using C#, Razor/Blazor, CSS and JavaScript, applying responsive design, accessibility and reusable design-system patterns.

Measure and optimise end-to-end quality, latency, reliability and cost, including the application behaviour around non-deterministic AI responses.

Software delivery and operational excellence

Own features through design, implementation, code review, automated testing, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
Create unit, component, integration, contract and end-to-end tests using TypeScript, PowerShell and C# where appropriate, including test strategies for AI-enabled and streaming user journeys.

Containerise applications and deploy to Azure services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps or AKS, as appropriate.
Instrument applications with logs, metrics, traces and usage telemetry; diagnose production issues and participate in incident response and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to secure coding, accessibility, privacy, Responsible AI, architecture and engineering standards across the AI application portfolio.

Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to turn ambiguous business needs into measurable, testable software requirements and incremental delivery plans.
Provide technical direction through solution design, architecture discussions, code reviews and pragmatic trade-off decisions.
Mentor engineers in full-stack design, software quality, AI integration and production engineering practices.
Create reusable components, reference implementations and development patterns that help multiple AI teams deliver consistently.
Communicate technical risks, dependencies and options clearly to engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

You will probably enjoy this role if you like combining hands-on development with technical problem-solving and collaboration.
